verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration case service with a case-preparation platform, so user-configured automations are a fair question for its software. However, the evidence describes only human-led services (case managers, attorney review) and document upload and tracking. Nothing shows users can set up autonomous background automations. The 'handles the petitions, timelines' claim describes the service team's work, not a user-configurable automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
